🚀 We’re Hiring | SDE 2 – Backend | Cultsport | Bengaluru
We’re looking for a Backend SDE 2 to join the engineering team at Cultsport and build scalable, high-impact products used by millions of users.
📍 Location: Bangalore
💼 Experience: 3–5 years
👨💻 Role: SDE 2 – Backend
🏢 Company: Cultsport

What we’re looking for:
3–5 years of experience in backend software development.
Strong hands-on experience in Python and backend development frameworks.
Good understanding of DSA, OOP, databases, APIs, and system design.
Experience building scalable, reliable, and high-performance backend services.
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, microservices, SQL/NoSQL databases, caching, and messaging systems.
Strong problem-solving skills with the ability to design and develop robust backend solutions.
Strong problem-solving skills and a passion for building great products.
Ability to take ownership and work effectively in a fast-paced environment.

What you’ll work on:
Design and develop scalable backend services and APIs.
Build and improve systems that power Cultsport products and experiences.
Work closely with product, design, and engineering teams.
Solve challenging scalability, performance, and reliability problems.
If you’re interested in building technology that impacts millions of users and want to be part of the Cultsport engineering team, we’d love to hear from you! 🚀
